items.title: Charles McPherson interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: it was like Charles Ives, it was just superimposed

ctx.x: Was there any attempt to figure out, well, what key is his piece in?

Well it didn’t make any difference. In fact, the fact that it was happening, it was just super — it was like Charles Ives, it was just superimposed, it didn’t make any difference. And in fact it worked really well, it was very, very interesting.
